name: Rock Mechanics Lab
description: Tests and test procedures, rock samples, rock specimen preparation, rock coring, cutting and lapping. Tolerance limits. Physical properties of rocks: water absorption, density, specific gravity, porosity, void index, electrical resistivity and sonic wave velocity of rocks samples. Mechanical properties: uniaxial compression, point load index and Brazilian strength tests of rocks, strain measurements and elastic properties of rocks. Effect of L/D ratio and saturation on rocks. Strength anisotropy in rocks. Shear tests in rocks: single, double, oblique tests, punch shear, triaxial compression tests, direct shear test. Slake durability and permeability tests for rocks. Classification. Codal provisions for rocks.
